headline: Sunday discipline saves your goal, act now.
summary: You're 0.72 kg/week behind pace with only 316 days to lose 33 kg; today's eating discipline and movement are non-negotiable.
details: Stop emotional snacking today—use Huel pre-portioned meals and drink water when cravings hit; commit to 50 minutes rowing or 45 minutes on the treadmill. You've gained 0.4 kg in 30 days and Sunday is your known weakness window, which means today's choices compound into your biggest recovery opportunity. Every single day of delay now costs you exponentially—prove you're serious by executing today.
